topic: Can the filter's suppression of 19th harmonics improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations?
consensus_response: Suppressing 19th harmonics reduces intermodulation products, enhancing spectral efficiency and transponder performance. Optimized filter design mitigates effects like insertion loss and group delay, ensuring efficient power allocation and reduced distortion in dense payload configurations.
reference_context: Satellite communications involve nonlinear distortions and intermodulation products, affecting power efficiency and spectral usage.
